name: porma
description: Porma is a lightweight dependency-free .blck frontend framework.

scripts.pack:dry-run: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @blcklab/porma && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @blcklab/porma-compiler && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @blcklab/porma-vite && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @blcklab/porma-router && npm pack --dry-run --workspace create-porma
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:examples && npm run check:vscode && npm run bench:compiled && npm run bench:matrix && npm run pack:dry-run && npm run package:vscode
scripts.verify:publish: npm run verify && npm run release:summary
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run verify && npm run pack:dry-run
